statement.p: Ken sells cars for a living. Each month, he earns {\$1{,}800.00} of base pay, plus a certain percentage of commission from his sales.
One month, Ken made {\$75{,}700.00} in sales, and earned a total of {\$4{,}282.96} in that month (including base pay and commission). What percent commission did Ken earn?

solution.p: Kens pay is made up of base pay and commission. In that month, Ken earned a total of {\$4{,}282.96}, with {\$1{,}800.00} of base pay. This implies Ken earned {\$4{,}282.96}-{\$1{,}800.00}={\$2{,}482.96} in commission, out of {\$75{,}700.00} in sales.
